_comment: 9834 Raven on a stone wall at Natural Bridge, Bryce, with the arch and a foggy canyon behind (R5 II CR3, 25 mm f/11 1/80 ISO 250, 8192x5464, doc cropped to 16:9). Final Camera Raw Filter as read after pass 2 + the user's AI-mask refresh (doc 438 / layer 2); the user saved the TIFF afterwards and confirmed no further change (the TIFF itself was not re-read). $BigT (AI-mask and object-mask bitmaps) omitted: Subject, Vegetation, Mountains (Landscape 50002) and an unused Sky (Landscape 50006) are AI masks; Mountains carries the user's 9 object, 5 brush and 1 Color Range subtractions; 'right front corner' is 2 object masks - none can be replayed from this JSON. $Rtch holds one user-painted Generative Remove patch (heal_patchmatch / firefly; target not recorded). The 'Sky ramp' (gradient ∩ Luminance Range) and 'Vignette' (inverted radial minus a cloned Subject component) are scripted and replay. After any scripted write the user must refresh the AI masks in the dialog.

raw_so_manual.Other: Generative Remove painted by the user in the filter (see $Rtch); no denoise

ai_masks_user: Mountains (Landscape 50002) minus Brush 1-5, Object 1-9, Color Range 'trees' (fog valley, hazy hills, trees, wall, raven kept out)
Sky (Landscape 50006) - made, cut off at the top right, not used (parametric Sky ramp instead)
right front corner: Object 1-2 (the stone wall)

crop._note: 16:9, 8192x4608; layer bounds top -856 height 5464 after the crop
